name: pin-board
description: Pins standing notes with /pin that Claude keeps following after /compact and /clear; shows them in one row above the prompt or as a counter, and keeps them per folder with --keep

display.title: Where pins show
display.description: band: the pins in one row above the prompt. counter: only their number, at the right end of the line under the prompt.

skipSystemPrompt.title: Skip the system prompt
skipSystemPrompt.description: Stops the "prompt.compose hook was skipped" notice by not adding the pins to the system prompt, the step Claude Code's Security default sends past pin-board. The pins then always go with your first message and the first after a compaction or /clear, as they already do where Security default runs first. On other setups, leave it off to keep them in the system prompt.
